problem: Company level reporting was enabled. Server delivery used only legacy approved-driver lookups, did not resolve canonical identities or verified legacy chat aliases, and swallowed delivery failures after processing. The older WB T client fallback writes directly to chat; live rules deny those writes.
implementation: Resolve exact canonical or reciprocal legacy driver identity, enforce profile company and chat company/membership, read current company setting/template, and use processed tankAfterInches instead of a single-tank guess. Stable per-packet/per-company/per-driver message IDs and Firestore transactions deduplicate concurrent fast-path/event retries. Duplicate retries leave newer human-message previews intact. Recipient creation races and transient failures remain retryable. No name-based ownership fallback.
durability: New deliverProcessedLevelReport RTDB create listener on packets/processed/{packetId}, with platform retry enabled. It runs independently after processed persistence, even if intake acknowledgement or the app ends. levelReportDeliveryVersion2 gates activation to the new stable-ID producer during rolling deployment. Original processor fast path delegates to the same identity. Missing identity and unmeasured levels are skipped rather than attributed or calculated speculatively.

deployments.sequence: Created retry worker first, then updated intake processor, using exact clean pushed source. Worker deploy --force acknowledged only the explicitly scoped new failure policy. No other function, Hosting, app, rules or bucket deployment.
